snip.t: Substance use disorder: Benzodiazepines can be misused and are dangerous with alcohol and opioids.
Consider physical illness, medicines and substance use that may cause psychiatric symptoms.
Seen in: Schizophrenia, mania, psychotic depression, delirium — Schizophrenia, delirium, substance use, epilepsy — Delirium, anxiety, fatigue; can be normal
The same symptom occurs in many disorders (hallucinations in schizophrenia, delirium, substance use, epilepsy).
Check special populations (children, pregnancy and lactation, medical illness, substance use), adherence, polypharmacy and stigma before and during any prescription.
Family therapy and group therapy use relationships and peer support; motivational interviewing builds the person's own motivation to change, especially in substance use.
Family therapy: Improves communication, reduces relapse and strengthens family dynamics — Schizophrenia, substance use disorders
